propositions: A new blocking check p10_verification_presence must pass leaf plans with a Testing or Verification H2 section, or with AC items containing backtick-fenced code, or matching the verification vocabulary regex (pytest, test_*, make, rebar, git, grep, assert, checked, verif*, exit code).

A new blocking check p11_ac_vagueness uses a fixed lexicon with word boundaries on both sides, excludes the term 'clean', and exempts vague matches that occur inside recorded inline code spans or within 30 characters after a span on the original line.
P6 advisory lexicon is updated to match the fixed p11_ac_vagueness boundary rules so both surfaces agree.
Ten enumerated backtest false-positive fixture lines (containing 'clean', 'etc.', and other vague terms in context) must not fire the p11_ac_vagueness blocking check.
Three enumerated positive cases ('works properly', 'handles errors etc. without adjacent code span', 'reasonable performance') must fire the p11_ac_vagueness blocking check.
P6 remains advisory; existing posture assertions in test_clarity_floor.py, test_det_floor_operator_attested.py, and test_det_citation.py are confirmed or adjusted without behavior change.
